# Analysis of % change in kelp grazed

Across three temperature treatments (9, 13, 16 C) and 2 predator treatments (with one live sunflower star or without)

```{r}
#| echo: false

knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(googlesheets4)
library(glmmTMB)

```

```{r}
#| message: false

#pulling data from web ---------------------------------------------------------
kelp <- googlesheets4::read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1hYKwyw7xpImw0UkSa-QuuZrkBy2YU88_AIKomJshBQA/edit?gid=1832909041#gid=1832909041",
                                  "Kelp weight") 

kelp_processed <- kelp %>%
  mutate(pcnt_grazed = ((Kelp_weight_before_g - Kelp_weight_after_g)/ 
                          Kelp_weight_before_g)*100) 
```

### Trials included in following graphs:

```{r}
#overview of kelp data
unique(subset(kelp_processed, !is.na(pcnt_grazed))$Trial)
```

### % Grazed over treatments

For all trials:

```{r}

#graph 
ggplot(data = subset(kelp_processed, !is.na(pcnt_grazed)), aes(x = Temp_treatment, y = pcnt_grazed, fill = Pred_treatment) ) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('grey','orange') ) +
  ylab("% Change Kelp Grazed") +
  labs(fill = "Pred treatment")

             
ggplot(data = subset(kelp_processed, !is.na(pcnt_grazed)), aes(x = Temp_treatment, y = pcnt_grazed, fill = Pred_treatment) ) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
           position = position_dodge()) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('grey','orange') ) +
  ylab("% Change Kelp Grazed") +
  labs(fill = "Pred treatment")
```

Per individual trial:

```{r}
#graph w facet wrap for trial
ggplot(data = subset(kelp_processed, !is.na(pcnt_grazed)), aes(x = Temp_treatment, y = pcnt_grazed, 
                                  fill = Pred_treatment) ) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('grey','orange') ) +
  ylab("% Change Kelp Grazed") +
  labs(fill = "Pred treatment") + 
  facet_wrap(~ Trial)



```

Plotting kelp continuously w temp values

```{r}

temp <- googlesheets4::read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/18vD4OGGKN3MY4Yx75_gLunwMmuHXkH9oBcuUNzi12KM/edit?gid=22340292#gid=22340292", "Experimental tanks") 

metadata_EF <- googlesheets4::read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1hYKwyw7xpImw0UkSa-QuuZrkBy2YU88_AIKomJshBQA/edit?gid=0#gid=0", "Trial info") %>% filter(Experiment == "Emergent effects")


avg_trial_temp <- temp %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Tank 1 temp (C)", "Tank 2 temp (C)","Tank 3 temp (C)",
                        "Tank 4 temp (C)","Tank 5 temp (C)","Tank 6 temp (C)",
                        "Tank 7 temp (C)","Tank 8 temp (C)","Tank 9 temp (C)"),
               names_to = "Tank",
               values_to = "Temp" ) %>%
  mutate(Tank = as.double(substr(Tank, 6,6) )) %>%
  rename(Trial = EF_Trial) %>%
  select(Date, Trial, Time,Tank,Temp) %>%  
  filter(!is.na(Trial)) %>%
  group_by(Trial, Tank) %>%
  summarise(mean_temp = mean(Temp, na.rm = TRUE))



kelp_wtemp <- left_join(kelp, avg_trial_temp, by = c("Tank", "Trial")) %>%
  mutate(pcnt_grazed = ((Kelp_weight_before_g - Kelp_weight_after_g)/ 
                          Kelp_weight_before_g)*100,
         weight_diff = Kelp_weight_before_g - Kelp_weight_after_g) 

kelp_wtemp <- unique(kelp_wtemp)

#PLOT
ggplot(data = kelp_wtemp, aes(x = mean_temp, y = pcnt_grazed, color = Pred_treatment) ) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline() +
  theme_classic() +
  ylab("% Change Kelp Grazed") +
  labs(fill = "Pred treatment") 

ggplot(data = kelp_wtemp, aes(x = mean_temp, y = pcnt_grazed) ) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", position = "dodge") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2) +
  ylab("% Change Kelp Grazed") +
  labs(fill = "Pred treatment") + 
  facet_wrap(~ Pred_treatment)

  
#model

             

```
